_meta.indication: NEMLUVIO is indicated for the treatment of adults with prurigo nodularis.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group; randomized 2:1 to nemolizumab or placebo; 24-week duration.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults at least 18 years of age with a clinical diagnosis of prurigo nodularis (PN) for at least six months.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary: improvement of ≥4 from baseline in PP-NRS at Week 16, and IGA success at Week 16 (IGA 0 [clear] or 1 [almost clear] with ≥2-grade improvement).
pivotal_trials.result: ≥4-point PP-NRS improvement at Week 16: 111 (58%) nemolizumab vs 16 (17%) placebo; adjusted difference 40% (95% CI 29%, 51%), p<0.0001. IGA score of 0 or 1: 50 (26%) vs 7 (7%); adjusted difference 15% (95% CI 7%, 23%), p=0.0025.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group; randomized 2:1 to nemolizumab or placebo; 16-week duration.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults at least 18 years of age with a clinical diagnosis of prurigo nodularis (PN) for at least six months.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary: improvement of ≥4 from baseline in PP-NRS at Week 16, and IGA success at Week 16 (IGA 0 [clear] or 1 [almost clear] with ≥2-grade improvement).
pivotal_trials.result: ≥4-point PP-NRS improvement at Week 16: 103 (56%) nemolizumab vs 19 (21%) placebo; adjusted difference 37% (95% CI 26%, 48%), p<0.0001. IGA score of 0 or 1: 69 (38%) vs 10 (11%); adjusted difference 29% (95% CI 19%, 38%), p<0.0001.

key_safety: No deaths were reported with nemolizumab in the phase 3 trials; serious adverse events were more common in placebo. Most common adverse reactions (≥1% and more frequent than placebo) through Week 16: headache (6% vs 3%), dermatitis atopic (4% vs 0.5%), eczema (4% vs 2%), and eczema nummular (3% vs 0%). Hypersensitivity reactions (e.g., facial angioedema) have been reported.
target_moa: Nemolizumab-ilto is a humanized IgG2 monoclonal antibody that inhibits IL-31 signaling by binding selectively to the IL-31 receptor alpha (IL-31RA), competitively blocking binding of IL-31 and subsequent activation of the JAK/STAT pathway. IL-31 is a cytokine involved in pruritus, inflammation, epidermal dysregulation, and fibrosis.

rems.type: Safety risks have not been identified that require risk management beyond standard pharmacovigilance. A REMS is not recommended for this application.

advisory_committee.vote: An Advisory Committee meeting was not held, because no unexpected or significant safety/efficacy issue or controversial/challenging issue was identified that would benefit from discussion at an Advisory Committee meeting.

summary.text: BLA 761390 for nemolizumab-ilto was submitted by Galderma and received Priority review; the drug had been granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation. Approval was by the traditional pathway based on two adequate and well-controlled trials (OLYMPIA 1 and 2), with no advisory committee convened.
